representation_fit.evidence: Primary representation is a directed, typed dependency network (24 nodes / 33 edges, data.js:5-77) rendered as an always-resident SVG graph — exactly the brief's relational-web shape where relationships are the content. Relations are first-class: edge click inspection (app.js:223, 404-425), relation detail list titled '关系是一等内容 · 点击查看' (app.js:493), 4 typed edge kinds with direction semantics 'A→B = A 依赖 B' (app.js:20-26, 516), and per-type filter chips (app.js:169-172, index.html:26).

primary_task_salience.evidence: The primary task (follow dependencies/influence) is the default state at load: app.js:97 and app.js:665 pre-focus hub 'dws_trade', so the initial screen (both screenshots) already shows a follow in progress — highlighted upstream (cyan) / downstream (orange), breadcrumb trail, and the inspector's 上游依赖/下游影响/关系明细 panels occupy the full right column; the graph canvas takes ~2/3 of the viewport.

time_to_understand.evidence: What/where is stated redundantly and immediately: title '依赖全景 — 关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' (index.html:6), header counts + arrow semantics (app.js:516, visible top-left in both screenshots), legend 'A → B 表示 A 依赖 B' plus edge dash/color coding (index.html:54, styles.css:232-238), context badge explaining highlight-vs-dim, and a home-state explainer with hub list and keyboard cheatsheet (app.js:427-442). Model-judged proxy only; comprehension cost on the initial screen is minimal despite graph density.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero modes, one step to the primary object: default focus pre-loaded (app.js:665); any node follows in one click (app.js:257); search '/' focus + arrows + Enter (app.js:630-642, 648); hub shortcut list sorted by degree (app.js:428-435); breadcrumb crumbs jump back to any path position (app.js:366-371, 589-594); full state deep-linkable via hash p/d/e/off (app.js:109-134; also exercised in source/capture-evidence.ps1:24-32).

context_loss.evidence: Directly engineers the acceptance seed: non-relevant nodes/edges are dimmed (opacity 0.12/0.14), never removed (app.js:296-297, 343); layout is computed once at boot and never re-run during follow, so positions are stable (app.js:50-94, called only at app.js:661); badge states '24 对象 / 33 关系均可见 ｜ 高亮 N 节点 · M 关系 ｜ 其余弱化保留' (app.js:388-390, visible top-center in both screenshots); legend note '弱化 = 保留在上下文中' (index.html:57).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Single permanent screen whose every surface serves the follow task: topbar (search, 1跳/2跳/全链路 depth seg app.js:21-25, 4 type chips), canvas, trail bar (index.html:48-51), context badge, legend (needed for 6 node × 4 edge types), inspector. No modals, wizards, or dead chrome. Only nit: object/relation counts appear both in the topbar stats and the badge (app.js:516 vs 388-390), trivial duplication.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.focus_order pass, a11y.target_size pass, but a11y.contrast fail and type.min_projected_size fail. Positive affordances: :focus-visible outlines (styles.css:88, 103, 189), ARIA combobox/listbox search (index.html:17-19), SVG role=img aria-label (index.html:31-32), documented keyboard scheme /, Backspace, Esc, 1/2/0 (app.js:437-441, 644-658), generous SVG hit targets r+9 (app.js:253-255). Gaps: graph nodes/edges are click-only SVG with no tabindex/role (app.js:233-266), so keyboard users reach objects only via search/inspector; and the two failing checks are consistent with deliberately faint dimmed elements (app.js:296-297 opacity 0.12) and small type (10-11.5px: styles.css:133-152, 294).

frontend_rework.evidence: Structural checks all pass: layout.overflow pass, layout.responsive_collision pass, text.truncation pass; both screenshots show no overflow, collision, or truncated text at 1280x860 or 1440x900, and labels stay legible over edges via stroke halo (styles.css:139-141). Rework implied only by the two typographic/contrast failures (check ids a11y.contrast fail, type.min_projected_size fail), which would require bumping font sizes/contrast rather than layout changes.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' is addressed verbatim and mechanically: page title states it (index.html:6); follow preserves the whole graph (dim-not-remove: app.js:296-297, 343), fixed node positions (layout once at app.js:661), live count of highlighted vs retained (app.js:388-390), trail breadcrumb with back/全景 (app.js:366-373), and hash round-trip of path/depth/edge/filters (app.js:125-139). Multi-hop semantics supported via BFS up/down at depths 1/2/∞ respecting filters (app.js:175-191).

defects_observed: Receipt check a11y.contrast: fail — consistent with intentionally dimmed graph elements (opacity 0.12 nodes / 0.14 edges, app.js:296-297, 343) and low-emphasis text tokens (--text-3 #66739a on #0c1120, styles.css:10, 47).
Receipt check type.min_projected_size: fail — smallest type is 10-11.5px (SVG node labels 11.5px and edge labels 10.5px, styles.css:133-152; stat sublabels 10px, styles.css:294).

SVG graph nodes/edges lack keyboard focusability (no tabindex/role/button semantics on generated circles/paths, app.js:215-266); keyboard path to arbitrary objects exists only through search or inspector lists.
Minor code redundancy, no visible effect: 'byId[isUp ? s.node : s.node]' has identical branches (app.js:496).
At 1280x860 the dense graph center places node labels over crossing edges; the paint-order stroke halo (styles.css:139-141) keeps them readable, but the region is busy.
missing_evidence: The sanitized receipt reports a11y.contrast and type.min_projected_size as fail but does not identify which elements/values failed, so the exact failing surfaces could only be inferred from styles, not confirmed (scores did not require it).
scores.overall_note: This package is a close match to the brief's understand × relational-web cell: the primary representation is a directed, typed dependency network in which relationships are first-class (edge inspector, relation detail list with 本⟶对端 direction, per-type filters), and the primary task is not just reachable but pre-loaded — the initial screen at both 1280x860 and 1440x900 opens already focused on hub dws_trade with upstream/downstream highlighting, a breadcrumb trail, and an inspector organized around 上游依赖 / 下游影响 / 关系明细 (app.js:97, 665). The acceptance seed 'relationship following without losing global context' is engineered rather than claimed: the full 24-node/33-edge graph stays resident with non-relevant content dimmed to opacity 0.12 (app.js:296-297, 343), node positions are computed once and never re-laid-out during follow (app.js:661, 50-94), a context badge continuously reports 'all visible / N highlighted / rest retained' (app.js:388-390), and path/depth/edge/filter state round-trips through the URL hash (app.js:125-139). Navigation is one click or one keystroke to any object, with search combobox ARIA, keyboard shortcuts, and deep-linkable states. The deductions come from the receipt and its visible correlates: a11y.contrast and type.min_projected_size fail (check ids), plausibly tied to the deliberately faint dimmed layer and 10-11.5px minimum type, and graph nodes themselves are not keyboard-focusable, so keyboard users depend on search/inspector routes. All seven structural checks (overflow, responsive collision, truncation, focus order, target size) pass and both screenshots show a defect-free layout. Task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot; model-judged legibility of the initial screen is used as the time-to-understand proxy, and no human-preference claim is made.
